dialogues.speaker: Arayash
dialogues.text: Festival Utsava... a bit troublesome... Must take good care of this place, must take good care of everyone's safety...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Something's on your mind?

dialogues.speaker: Arayash
dialogues.text: Ah, it's the Golden Nara...

dialogues.speaker: Arayash
dialogues.text: How embarrassing... Festival Utsava should be a happy festival for everyone, but when thinking about how some very bad people will try to intrude on this festival, it's not nice anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Arayash
dialogues.text: So I am a little unhappy...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Statue of The Seven...

dialogues.speaker: Arayash
dialogues.text: This is the stone of the Lord of Trees and the Lord of Dendro! It's very important!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Arayash
dialogues.text: Goodbye, Golden Nara. I hope you won't meet any bad guys.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I will defeat the bad guys.

dialogues.speaker: Arayash
dialogues.text: Golden Nara looks skilled enough to defeat bad guys.

dialogues.speaker: Arayash
dialogues.text: But Arayash doesn't want Golden Nara's help, because Golden Nara is the guest of Aranara.

dialogues.speaker: Arayash
dialogues.text: Festival Utsava is over, and Marana has been defeated too. Vanarana is safe.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You seem rather pleased.

dialogues.speaker: Arayash
dialogues.text: #Yes, because Marana was defeated by the amazing Nara {NICKNAME} and Arama.

dialogues.speaker: Arayash
dialogues.text: For Aranara, there is no need to worry about encountering aggressive bad guys outside of Vanarana.

dialogues.speaker: Arayash
dialogues.text: #This is all thanks to Nara {NICKNAME} and Arama.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Arayash
dialogues.text: #Goodbye. The Lord of Trees and Lord of Dendro will watch over Nara {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Arayash
dialogues.text: The festival... We must still keep our guard up.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Statue of The Seven...

dialogues.speaker: Arayash
dialogues.text: This is the stone of the Lord of Dendro! It's very important!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Arayash
dialogues.text: #Goodbye. The Lord of Dendro will watch over Nara {NICKNAME}.
